findings.pdf_says: 8.8.4.1.1.4 Comparison of a numeric integer operand with an operand of class alphanumeric or national
findings.markdown_says:
###### 8.8.4.1.1.4 Comparison of a numeric integer operand with an operand of class alphanumeric or

national
findings.why_it_matters: The two-line printed heading was split: its last word 'national' became a separate body paragraph, so the heading is truncated (reads as comparison with class 'alphanumeric or') and a stray fragment appears as prose.

findings.pdf_says:
a) If NUMERIC is specified,
1. If the category of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is numeric,
a. If the usage of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is implicitly or explicitly display or national, ...
b. If the usage of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is not display or national, ...
2. If the category of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is not numeric, ...
findings.markdown_says:
a) If NUMERIC is specified,

   1\. If the category of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is numeric,

   a. If the usage of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is implicitly or explicitly display or national, ...

   b. If the usage of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is not display or national, ...

   2\. If the category of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is not numeric, ...
findings.why_it_matters: In the PDF (8.8.4.1.3.3 GR2) items 1./2. are nested under a), and items a./b. are nested a further level under 1.; the markdown puts a), 1., a., b. and 2. all at one indentation, so the sub-items a./b. (usage display vs. not display) read as siblings of a) rather than as cases of 'category is numeric', and the a./b. labels collide with the a)/b) rule labels.

findings.markdown_says:
b) If ALPHABETIC is specified, the condition is true in the following circumstances:

   1\. If a locale is in effect for character classification, ...

   2\. If a locale is not in effect for character classification, ...

   c) If ALPHABETIC-LOWER is specified, ...
findings.why_it_matters: In the PDF the 1./2. locale cases are indented under each of b), c) and d) (8.8.4.1.3.3 GR2); the markdown places them at the same indentation as b), c), d), detaching them from their parent items.
